message.reasoning_content: We are asked about the causal direction between P38 (p38 MAPK) and plcg (phospholipase C gamma, PLCγ1). In T cell signaling, PLCγ1 is activated upon T cell receptor engagement, generating IP3 and DAG, leading to calcium mobilization and PKC activation, which can lead to activation of MAPK pathways including p38. So PLCγ1 is upstream of p38 in TCR signaling. Thus, plcg -> P38. Confidence is high (0.9+). constraint_type: hard_required because it's a well-established pathway.
